name: PAINTBRUSH!
description: P A I N T B R U S H ! Flux, despite it's immense stylistic versatility, falls short when trying to produce painterly images quite often. It's tendency to produce clean, crisp imagery which is very desirable for other styles, results in the loss of brushstroke textures and general style that comes from paint . Introducing P A I N T B R U S H ! , the Lora that makes flux capable of a wide variety of painterly styles whilst maintaining flux dev's prompt adherence and compositional superiority. Trigger words for this LoRA are: Painting & Painterly . Use both of these terms together in various parts of your natural language prompt to produce the most significant effect. Below are example side-by-side images which use the same seed. The left side image in each pair does not use the LoRA, but the Right side of the pair uses the LoRA at 0.9 strength . This LoRA could not be possible without its vast, beautiful dataset donated by my good friend Gallifrey ! Enjoy!
